title: Elegant 5BR Rosemary Beach Home with Private Beach Access
meta_description: Relax in this elegant 5BR, 5.5BA Rosemary Beach, FL home with private beach access, a private pool, a spacious great room, and a carriage house. Sleeps 12.
description_expanded: DescriptionWelcome to Harper Cottage & Carriage House, a refined Rosemary Beach retreat designed for unforgettable coastal gatherings. Blending timeless European charm with elevated modern comfort, this home offers the rare combination of privacy, luxury, and access to one of 30A’s most sought-after communities.From the moment you step through the signature curved entry, you’re greeted by light-filled interiors, exposed wood beams, and an effortless sense of calm sophistication—the kind of place where mornings start slow and evenings linger a little longer.✨ Your Private Outdoor OasisAt the heart of the home is a secluded courtyard with a private saltwater pool—a true luxury in Rosemary Beach. Whether you're cooling off after the beach or enjoying a quiet evening swim, this space is designed for relaxation.Optional pool heat available ($45/day plus tax) Comfortable outdoor seating + natural gas grill for alfresco diningCompletely private—perfect for families or small groups Designed for Gathering (and Space to Spread Out)The open-concept living space is both elegant and inviting, ideal for hosting and reconnecting:Chef’s kitchen with marble countertops, limestone backsplash, and professional-grade appliancesLarge island + dining table for shared meals and conversationComfortable living room with ample seating and large TVEvery bedroom features an ensuite bath, offering privacy and comfort for all guests—an important detail that consistently drives bookings. Flexible Sleeping for Families & GroupsFirst-floor guest suite (ideal for multi-generational stays)Luxurious primary suite with spa-like bath and private sitting areaBunk room + daybed perfect for kids or teensAdditional guest suite with queen bed Private Carriage House = Built-In Bonus SpaceA standout feature guests love:The separate 1-bedroom carriage house acts as a private retreat within your stay—perfect for guests wanting added privacyIncludes full kitchen, living area, and sleeping accommodations. The Rosemary Beach ExperienceWhen you stay here, you’re not just booking a home—you’re stepping into one of the most iconic communities on 30A:Multiple private beach access points (rare and highly valued)Several resort-style community poolsCharming butterfly garden & playgroundWalkable to shops, dining, and events in Rosemary BeachPlus, enjoy 4 complimentary adult bikes to explore everything the area has to offer.⭐ Why Guests Choose This Home✔ Private heated saltwater pool ✔ Separate carriage house for flexibility + privacy✔ All bedrooms have ensuite bathrooms✔ Located in the heart of Rosemary Beach with exclusive access perks✔ Perfect balance of luxury + comfort for families and groups Make It Your 30A EscapeWhether you're planning a family vacation, celebrating a special occasion, or simply craving a relaxing coastal getaway, Harper Cottage offers the space, style, and setting to make it unforgettable.Book now and experience why guests return to Rosemary Beach year after year.
